title: WIT EventStudyConfig (Class B) — wire config v1
$comment: Machine copy of the WIT-03 §3.5 EventStudyConfig, corrected to match the engine (WIT-P3c-1): the event is body >= k * trailing-median body (NOT k*ATR), and the path split is three thresholds (spike_eff, spike_giveback_cap, pullback_p) rather than a single path_efficiency_split. Mode/enum tokens are the Class-B dimensions in contract/modes.md; an out-of-vocabulary mode -> UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT. config_version stays 1.0.

k.description: HONOURED — body >= k * trailing-median body; a positive multiple.

n_baseline.description: HONOURED — trailing-candle count for the median-body baseline; positive.

spike_eff.description: HONOURED. A FRACTION (0.50 = fifty percent), NOT a percent: efficiency >= spike_eff (event_study.py). A prose value like 50 would make the spike bucket empty; constrain to [0,1].

spike_giveback_cap.description: HONOURED. A FRACTION: retrace_pct <= spike_giveback_cap. Constrain to [0,1].

pullback_p.description: HONOURED. A FRACTION: retrace_pct >= pullback_p. Constrain to [0,1].

regime_er_m.description: HONOURED — Kaufman ER lookback (prior candles); positive.

regime_trailing_window.description: HONOURED — trailing window (candles) for the ER median; positive.

regime_fixed_er.description: HONOURED. A FRACTION (Kaufman efficiency ratio, 0.30 = thirty percent), NOT a percent: er >= regime_fixed_er (event_study.py). Constrain to [0,1].

regime_adx_thresh.description: HONOURED — ADX threshold on the 0-100 scale.

conditions.description: Regime split labels evaluated per event, e.g. regime_chop / regime_trend.
